criteria.name: LLM Explanations & Prompt Engineering
criteria.guidance: Summarize validated forecasts with horizon, uncertainty and source metrics; do not invent sales values or business impact.

criteria.name: RAG: Ingestion/Retrieval/Grounding
criteria.guidance: Retrieve from approved forecasting documents with source metadata and evidence-grounded responses.

criteria.name: Text-to-SQL & Query Safety
criteria.guidance: Create schema-aware read-only SQL, reject unsafe statements and validate date ranges/aggregation logic.

criteria.name: AI Agent Orchestration
criteria.guidance: Coordinate sales queries, forecast lookup, document retrieval and summarization with traceable tool routing.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Responsible AI
criteria.guidance: Test groundedness, time-period correctness, prompt injection, privacy and unsupported claims; document failure cases.
